_comment: Emitted by src/schedule/schedule.ts from the conformed bar-chart fixture. Frames @30fps. The event schedule is computed from the props (bar i finishes at delay + i*stagger + duration); the beats pin to those events with lead/lag in ms. This is the reference the previz renders — regenerated whenever the fixture timing changes.

conform.note: slowed from onda default 24f/4f so beats have room

events.desc: Citations settles — the outlier, red, tallest

beats.text: the last one should worry you
there it is — citations. two-thirds, made up
Horizontal bars grow from zero on a calm spring; the biggest bar earns the one accent, the rest stay ink. Dies past ~8 bars — it becomes a table pretending to be a chart.
